from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """One legal document with its assigned cause category."""
    doc_title: str | None = Field(description="The document title or identifier (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause/category identified for this document")
    doc_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., judgment, ruling)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
